description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelRelFieldEditButton, which extends SugarWidgetField. The class provides methods for rendering a header cell and a list view for a subpanel relation field, including an inline script to open an edit properties panel for a related module. The file is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically customizing subpanel widgets with an edit button.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelRelFieldEditButton
classes.description: A widget class providing an edit button for subpanel relationship fields, with methods to display header cells and list entries, including JavaScript actions to invoke editing panels.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Returns a non-breaking space to render as the header cell for the subpanel relation field.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Intended to generate the HTML for the list view of the subpanel relation field. Currently contains a debug statement and script for editing related properties via a popup panel.
